method: Built-in image_gen tool; one generation per bag using supplied model review image as subject reference.

icons.name: Runecloth Bag
icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: custom square inventory item icon for a classic fantasy game addon, ultimately displayed at 32 to 64 pixels. Input image is a strict subject reference: use the actual supplied bag, its exact color, silhouette, flap, straps, hardware and pocket construction. Make ONE original hand-painted game icon, bold restrained brushwork, clean readable chunky shapes, dark creases, warm upper-left highlights and a subtle rim so it reads small. Center the whole bag as a large close-up occupying 86% of the square; slight three-quarter view like the reference. Nearly black warm-brown plain vignette background with subtle halo behind the bag. No lettering, labels, numbers, watermark, border, frame, extra objects or decorations. No invented straps, pockets or fantasy ornaments. Preserve the real reference construction, simplify only surface texture. Runecloth Bag/Dark Schoolbag: tall slim rectangular deep muted reddish-chocolate brown leather satchel, large long rectangular flap covering most of front, TWO small short buckle straps near the flap's lower corners, silver buckles and silver studs. Preserve this exact slim hard-edged silhouette and long flap; no extra pockets or long straps.
